主要内容: On February 6, 2015, the board of directors of Insperity, Inc. decided to extend the deadline for stockholders to nominate directors and propose other business for the 2015 annual meeting. The original deadline was February 12, 2015, but it was extended to February 27, 2015. Any nominations or proposals received by the company by the close of business on February 27, 2015, and complying with the company's bylaws, may be submitted to stockholders at the annual meeting. This change was made to allow more time for stockholders to participate in the meeting.
